item.title: Setting Up an FRP Service
item.description:
Why do I have to first ToDesk into a Windows machine, and then SSH from that machine into the server just to connect!? Unbearable. Let’s just set up an FRP service myself.

The image features the lovely Ms. Bagpipe. According to unverified sources, it’s likely drawn by artist Liyu黎 as a celebratory illustration for the 2022 Ambience Synesthesia concert. To match, let’s play Ms. Bagpipe’s personal EP: 《故乡的风》 (Wind of Home).
